eligibility.title: Verifika elegibilidade
eligibility.action: Uza deit regra atual Timor-Leste Manufacturing. Regra EPS jerál serve deit hanesan preparasaun.

registration.title: Rejistu Point System 9
registration.action: Ba rota Manufacturing Dili ne'ebé verifikadu, rejistu husi 2026-03-09 to'o 2026-03-18. Janela taka ona.

exam_fee.title: Taxa aplikasaun / ezame
exam_fee.action: KEP seidauk verifika taxa espesífika ba Manufacturing 9. La bele uza taxa nasaun seluk.

biometric.title: Verifika identidade
biometric.action: Tuir deit instrusaun atual Timor-Leste kona-ba identidade no anti-fraude.

document_verify.title: Verifika dokumentu rejistu
document_verify.action: Checklist passport/foto/upload/payment ba ronda 9 seidauk rekonstruidu hotu iha KEP.

exam_card.title: Anúnsiu data ezame
exam_card.action: Ba Manufacturing Dili, HRD Korea hatudu 2026-06-09 hanesan loron anúnsiu ezame.

eps_topik.title: EPS-TOPIK — Point System 9 Manufacturing
eps_topik.action: Ba Manufacturing Dili, periodu ezame 2026-06-18 to'o 2026-07-30. General CBT no Point System.

skill_competency.title: Skills Test — Ronda 2
skill_competency.action: HRD Korea publika entrada kandidatu skills East Timor 4 iha 2026-09-22, maibé ligasaun site/sector seidauk prova.

final_selection.title: Seleksaun final tuir pontu
final_selection.action: La inferi rezultadu final husi lista kandidatu skills 2026-09-22. Presiza artifact final ronda 9 Manufacturing.

psychology_pre_job.title: Kontrola espesífiku Timor-Leste
psychology_pre_job.action: La iha stage psychology separadu ne'ebé verifikadu. La kopi regra Indonesia.

mcu1.title: Ezaminasaun médika
mcu1.action: Uza deit orientasaun medical/provider Timor-Leste atual. Provider/checklist/taxa seidauk map hotu.

job_application.title: Pasta kandidatu servisu
job_application.action: Depois final result verifikadu, tuir instrusaun atual NDOE/HRD Korea.

roster.title: EPS Job Seekers' Roster
roster.action: Kandidatu ofisiál deit mak tama prosesu employer selection. Intermediáriu privadu la bele garante prioridade.

employer_selection.title: Seleksaun husi empregadór Korea
employer_selection.action: Hein seleksaun liuhusi sistema EPS ofisiál. Intermediáriu privadu la bele garante empregadór espesífiku.

slc.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
slc.action: Se empregadór hili, tuir instrusaun Timor-Leste/EPS atual ba SLC.

post_slc_requirements.title: Rekizitu depois SLC
post_slc_requirements.action: Uza deit instrusaun atual ba medical follow-up, training, visa, payment no departure.

visa_docs.title: Dokumentu visa
visa_docs.action: Uza checklist no taxa visa atual husi Timor-Leste/Korean mission.

predeparture_training.title: Treinamentu antes departure
predeparture_training.action: Kompleta deit treinamentu ofisiál ne'ebé designadu.

mcu3_departure.title: Saúde final / prontu atu sai
mcu3_departure.action: La kria MCU-III estilo Indonesia automaticamente. Halo deit se instrusaun Timor-Leste husu.

departure.title: Departure ofisiál
departure.action: Sai deit depois contract, visa, training no rekizitu departure kompletu.

korea_entry_training.title: Tama Korea no employment education
korea_entry_training.action: Depois tama Korea, kompleta employment education no handover ofisiál.

employer_handover.title: Handover ba empregadór
employer_handover.action: Konfirma fatin servisu, alojamentu no kontaktu emerjénsia.

residence_registration.title: Residence Card / rejistu estranjeiru
residence_registration.action: Tuir regra Immigration Korea atual ba rejistu estranjeiru no Residence Card.

eps_insurance_check.title: Verifika seguransa EPS
eps_insurance_check.action: Verifika obrigasaun seguransa EPS husi fonte ofisiál.

first_payroll_check.title: Verifika saláriu dahuluk
first_payroll_check.action: Kompara payslip no bank deposit ho SLC, oras servisu, dedusaun no regra saláriu.

labor_support_ready.title: Prontu ba apoiu laborál
labor_support_ready.action: Rai kanal labor-support ofisiál no prova contract/payroll/attendance.

employment_maintenance.title: Mantén empregu / muda fatin servisu
employment_maintenance.action: Se iha razaun legál, uza prosesu EPS ka employment center Korea ofisiál.
